text:
kevin: Heads-up: sketching heuristics for 'ownership plumbing' — how we reassign service responsibilities without destabilizing runtime. Wanted quick feedback before I turn it into an RFC.

mara: Love it. Can you outline the guardrails? rollback story is key.

kevin: High level checklist I'm thinking: 1) narrow surface with explicit contracts (no implicit side-effects) 2) companion adapters/proxies for backward compat 3) phased traffic slicing + canary 4) auto-fallback to host surface on failure 5) observability + SLIs and reconciliation hooks. Short list for the RFC preface.

anita: For proxies — prefer thin adapters that only transform requests, no state. That avoids sync issues and makes rollbacks trivial. :100: 

mika: Quick Q: how do we handle KV cache ownership? It's the hotpath; moving it seems very risky for latency and correctness.

kevin: Two pragmatic options for KV:
A) Read-snapshot mode: new owner reads a snapshot API from old owner, no writes until cutover. Fast but needs snapshot freshness guarantees.
B) Dual-write then quiesce+reconcile: write to both owners, run a reconcile job to catch drift, then flip. Slower but stronger correctness. My bias: B for any data with strong correctness requirements; A if we must keep the p50 tight during migration.

mara: Dual-write implies a reconciliation playbook. Add monotonic op ids or vector timestamps and a metrics gate so we can prove convergence.

kevin: Exactly. Also drafting a few stability heuristics we'll require before a 100% cut:
- "no ownership cut that increases p50 by >5ms"
- "p99 regressions must be explainable and <10% increase"
- "reconciliation backlog must be <= 5 minutes for 24h before cut"
- "kill-switch route and automatic traffic divert in config"

anita: Can we codify the feature-flag lifecycle? Example config suggestion: 
```json
{
  "flag": "svc_ownership_kv_dualwrite",
  "phases": ["canary:5%","ramp:25%","quiesce:0.1%","cut:100%"],
  "rollback_on": ["error_rate>1%","p95_increase>20%"],
  "observability": ["trace_tag:owner","metric:reconcile_backlog_ms"]
}
```

mika: We should require tracing spans annotated with owner tag + correlation id so SRE can trace ownership boundary latencies. Also add synthetic prompt sets for quality regression checks (inference output checks) when moving model-serving surfaces.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout job created for the "svc_ownership_kv_dualwrite" flag. Plan window suggestion: 2024-06-18T21:00Z — finalize after RFC approval.

mara: Good. Next step: Kevin, can you convert this into an RFC with the migration playbook, the reconciliation checklist, and the SLI gating thresholds? I can pair with SRE to tighten thresholds.

kevin: Will do. I'll post a draft RFC + playbook by EOD tomorrow. Thanks for the quick takes. :raised_hands:
